source: EP-0168 (audit repo k4_machines_phase_break.py; decision rule committed before any K4 run) and EP-0176 (k4_hagelin_phase_break.py; decision rule committed before the K4 English-stage run). Exact injectivity tests for the rotors and Enigma; kernels checked against brute force (0 mismatches of 3,000), an existing simulator (0 of 3,960 letters) and Enigma I test vectors.

EP-0168.Hagelin: not run in EP-0168 (estimated 84 CPU h for the crib stage alone); run as EP-0176
EP-0168.Chaocipher: out of scope: its state is two alphabets permuted by the letters, with no step counter, so a phase break is not defined
EP-0168.not run: a slip of the fast Enigma rotor alone, without carries

EP-0176.model: M-209 type: six pinwheels 26/25/23/21/19/17, free pins, 1,107,567 no-overlap cages, C = 25 - P + k; one break (b, t) as above
EP-0176.planted_controls: not run (deferred by the researcher; a size-matched acceptance rule was prepared but not run)
EP-0176.verdict: undecidable: no climb reached 40.4, but the power of the climb is unknown and the shuffles are about 500 times smaller than K4
